description: Exclusive ocean view penthouse perched in the hills of Rincón. Featuring soaring open space, floor-to-ceiling glass, panoramic views, and an expansive terrace. This serene retreat feels suspended above the landscape, reflecting the vision of its New York architects. Private driveway, saltwater pool access, and just minutes from beaches, dining, and town — yet a world apart.The spaceThe villa is a multi-level property designed to provide privacy for each unit. Montaña Rusa sits atop a beautifully landscaped one-acre lot with breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea and surrounding greenery. A peaceful retreat away from the busy city, where blue sky meets the ocean and green valleys frame the view below. Each level features an open terrace for taking in the scenery, watching birds pass at eye level, and dining al fresco.Start your morning with coffee on the terrace, listening to birdsong and feeling the gentle breeze. At sunset, unwind with a glass of wine, watching the sky change colors and rain form over the ocean. Fall asleep to the orchestra of jungle sounds. Inside, the space is open and functional, with natural wood and stone materials adding warmth. Large windows and glass sliding doors flood every room with natural light and frame uninterrupted ocean views. The layout combines kitchen, dining, and living areas, all connected directly to the terrace.The Space- Top-floor penthouse with private driveway- Open living, dining, and kitchen layout- Large windows and sliding doors throughout- Private terrace with wide ocean and valley views- King bedroom with en-suite bathroom- Additional powder room- Shared pool and outdoor kitchen area- Ceiling fans and natural cross-ventilationWell suited for a quiet stay — whether that’s slowing down, reading, or using the terrace for yoga or meditation.Guest accessGuests have access to ground floor shared amenities, including a 35-foot saltwater pool, deck with lounge chairs, a full bathroom with washer and dryer, and an outdoor kitchen equipped with a refrigerator, sink, kitchen island, and poolside dining table.

description: Enjoy paradise at Casa Goyita located right on Rincon's famous Lala's Beach and just a quick walk to downtown! The second floor is all yours, first floor is unoccupied. Casa Goyita is a 4 Bedroom 2 Bath apartment that sleeps 10 comfortably and offers a modern interior, spacious high ceilings, AC, WiFi, lovely terrace with outdoor kitchen, direct beach access via private path, shaded pavilion, and outdoor shower for rinsing off.The spaceSpacious upstairs rental unit with two private entrances, one on front, one beach side. Reviews agree there is plenty of space for 10 to stay in comfort. The most unique aspect is the beautiful backyard that opens directly onto Lala’s beach and one of the best Rincón areas for ocean swimming. Three bedrooms have a Queen bed and one bedroom is Queen bed plus twin/twin bunk bed. Master has in suite bathroom. Second bathroom is off hallway.Guest accessThe entire second floor plus terrace, outdoor kitchen, path to beach, ample backyard, and shaded pergola are yours to enjoy.All beaches are public in Puerto Rico, so other beach goers will be on the sand and in their water, however, they can not see beyond the tree line so the backyard and terrace area retains privacy.PARKING.. on property behind the gate are two compact to mid-sized parking spots. Additional street parking is available on the MAIN STREET, wherever the curb is painted white, just a few yards from the house. NO PARKING IS ALLOWED IMMEDIATELY OUTSIDE THE GATE TO THE PROPERTY. We know this isn’t ideal, but please help us keep our neighbors happy by not parking on Calle Cambija.Other things to noteThe house was built in the late 1970’s by Goyita Ruiz. The grounds are still lovingly cared for and maintained by her son, Julio, who often comes by in the late mornings to sweep and tidy the large property and will gladly to give you a local history lesson if you ask. There are free roaming chickens that can create a need to keep up with this. If you prefer during your stay to personally sweep and hose the terrace and walkway, please let us know prior to your check in.

description: BREAKFAST WITH A BIG OCEAN VIEW!Located only seven houses up the road from Sandy Beach, You’ll be able to enjoy this quiet and quaint economical casita located in the heart of the well known Puntas neighborhood with it’s handful of restaurants, bars, food trucks, and other amenities like yoga, and surfboard rentals, and some of the best surf breaks. This casita is ideal for couples or solo travelers who want to get away, disconnect and enjoy Rincon at their own pace.The spaceNewly updated Casita with brand new kitchen and sliding glass doors to let in the ocean breeze. This casita is cozy and modern, ideal for couples or solo travelers. Enjoy beautiful ocean views, Wifi, AC in the bedroom, and is walkable to beaches and local restaurants / establishments. There is a sliding glass door in the kitchen to enjoy the small balcony to enjoy a beverage while taking in the ocean view/ sunset and hearing the waves. While this isn't a luxury hotel accommodation, this casita is quiet, cute, comfortable, clean, low key & very relaxing.The property has an automatic generator that powers on in the event of utility loss. Guests should be mindful of electric consumption while on backup generator power.Guest accessGuests will have access to their private rented casita.The parking, laundry and stairway are shared spaces for all of Cozy Casita guests to enjoy.Other things to noteThere are three (1-bedroom) casitas on property each with their own private patio or balcony area. The driveway, stairs and aundry are shared spaces for all of Cozy Casita guests to access.During your visit you may encounter some of the Caribbean wildlife that live among us. You may hear coquis (our endemic frog), roosters, horses and may receive the visit of iguanas in the trees.There are also many opportunities to observe birds like Venezuelan troupials, red hawks, Puerto Rican parrots and grey kingbirds. Rincon is full of small hills. This property happens to be on one so the driveway until getting used to it may seem a bit steep. A 4x4 is Not necessary.We reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-5 days) Exceptions to the rule applyWe are located on the western point of the island. We are 2.5 hours from SJU Airport, 35 minutes from both BQN & MAZ airports, and 1.5 hours from PSE Airport in Ponce. To avoid the drive from San Juan there is a Cape Air flight that goes direct multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ.
